description: Introducing the Lava Hero Shakti, featuring a 1.8” display and an impressive up to 7 days of battery standby time. It supports 22 languages for enhanced accessibility and offers 32GB expandable storage for your convenience. Its sturdy design and stylish keypad ensure durability and ease of use, while the Number Talker feature keeps you informed. Enjoy additional features like vibrator, wireless FM, instant torch, and Super Battery Mode for added functionality and convenience. Experience reliability and versatility with the Lava Hero Shakti keypad mobile for your perfect companion for everyday communication.
